DOCKLINE · Customs 04 surface materials

Concrete Floor 02, Wood Planks Dirt, and Rusty Metal 02 are CC0 assets from Poly Haven.

https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_planks_dirt

The warehouse/ WebP files are resized versions of the diffuse, OpenGL normal,
and roughness layers. DOCKLINE mixes the tiled photos with its own painted
loading-bay stripes, identification marks, tyre tracks and floor lighting.
